prompt:
Create ONE multi-item sprite atlas with exactly 24 DISTINCT Chinese xianxia game item icons, strict 6 columns x 4 rows of equal square cells. Match the attached existing game atlas as STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, replace all depicted objects with the roster below. This is one sheet containing MANY items, NOT a single large item. True transparent alpha background everywhere outside objects. Every complete icon including glow must fit central 64% of its own cell, with at least 18% empty transparent padding on every side. Nothing may cross a cell boundary. No visible grid, frames, lettering, labels, numbers, text, watermark. Cohesive vibrant hand-painted fantasy GAME ICONS: crisp silhouette readable at 40px, clear metallic/cloth highlights, restrained elemental accents, not photorealistic closeups. Distinguish blade versus staff, crown versus robe, boots and pendant. Equipment is displayed without wearer, body parts or mannequin. Entire weapons and both shoes fit inside their assigned cells. Vary physical shape and material according to each named origin, not just recolors. EXACT row-major order; names and IDs are metadata, NOT text to draw.
